en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large, ornate multi‑storey institutional building with Baroque Revival elements, a central entrance, and two prominent end pavilions. A fence and sidewalk run along the front, with a few pedestrians visible. The caption beneath the image is in Hungarian. The reverse side is blank except for pre‑printed Hungarian text and address lines.
